QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_43

question.text: Generally, how many CM (Clearing Member) accounts does a broker maintain per stock exchange?

answer.text: Generally one CM account per broker per stock exchange, with CDSL requiring multiple accounts and additional CM accounts permitted for F&O or SLBM
One for each clearing corporation, with no exceptions
Multiple accounts per stock exchange as a default rule
One combined account for all stock exchanges

explanation.text: The Logic: Generally, there is only one CM account per broker for a stock exchange. CDSL, however, requires multiple accounts, and additional CM accounts may be opened for F&O or SLBM segments. The Trap: A blanket 'one per clearing corporation' rule is not source exact and misses the CDSL and segment-specific exceptions. Note: Treat 'one per stock exchange' as the baseline, with CDSL and F&O/SLBM as defined exceptions.
